intro: The **Requisition List initializer** configures the drop-in for managing saved product lists and recurring orders. Use initialization to customize how requisition list data is displayed and enable internationalization for multi-language B2B storefronts.

langDefinitions.description: Language definitions for internationalization (i18n). Override dictionary keys for localization or branding.

RequisitionListModel.description: Transforms requisition list data from GraphQL including list details, items, quantities, and metadata. Use this to add custom fields or modify existing requisition list data structures.

RequisitionListItemModel.description: Transforms requisition list item data including product details, quantities, and custom options. Use this to add custom fields or modify item data structures.
